'''Mister Ripper''' was the trained [[Skinflayer]] of [[Thades Gorkultok]], a gladiator in the [[Arena Grand]] of [[Zakuul]]. In [[3630 BBY]] Thades was put up against a newcomer known as "[[Alliance Commander|the Mysterious Stranger]]" and was defeated in the sixth round of the Arena fights along with Mister Ripper.

==Behind the scenes==
Mister Ripper appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' as part of the sixth boss fight of "Eternal Championship."
